description:
Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Network Contracting Office (NCO 21) intends to award a sole source firm fixed price contract to ARJO INC  for 110 new Arjo ceiling lifts with installation on existing Arjo ceiling lift tracks to be used modify existing Arjo turntables for the Fresno VA Medical Center and Community Living Center. The procurement is on behalf of the Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, Regional Procurement Office West (RPOW), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21, on behalf of VA Central California Health Care System (VACCHCS).

The specific items required are as follows:

VA s Gray Market Items terms and conditions apply pursuant to VAAR 852.212-71 Gray Market Items and VAAR 852.212-72 Gray Market and Counterfeit Items.  As a result, vendor shall be an OEM, authorized dealer, authorized distributor or authorized reseller for the items identified to be eligible for participation with this acquisition.  Vendor must be able to provide the documentation that demonstrates such aforementioned authority.

The solicitation for this action will be posted to beta.sam.gov/GSA eBuy, and all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency.  After consideration, the Government will determine whether to proceed with the sole source acquisition.  Please keep in mind that patient care and choice in the decision is the highest priority to the VA. The solicitation will be posted in May.

Please respond to Mohammed.Hussain2@va.gov  no later than Thursday, April 14,2026, at 12:00 pm Pacific Standard Time.  With your response, please provide evidence showing compliance with the aforementioned Gray Market clauses.  Failure to provide the required information may result in a determination that your company is not 
a viable source.
